transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
Ever since they changed my position at the shop, I just can’t seem to adjust. It's really throwing off my work and my whole routine.
How long after the job change did these difficulties start, and have they been causing problems in other areas of your life as well?

It started really quickly, within a week or two of them switching my position. Since then, my new boss has already pulled me aside about my performance slipping, and at home I've been backing out of plans with friends and falling behind on my art commissions.
Have these symptoms been going on for more than 6 months since the job change, or have they improved at all over time?

No, it hasn't been six months yet—the change at work only happened about a month ago. And things definitely haven't improved; they started within a week or two of the shift and have only felt worse and more intense as time goes on.
Since the work change, have you been feeling more down, anxious, or overwhelmed than usual most days?

Yes, I feel this constant mix of dread and defeat, and I'm often on the verge of tears or snapping at people. When I get home, I'm so wound up and overwhelmed that I just sit on the couch instead of doing any of the hobbies I used to enjoy.
Before the job change, had you been feeling this way or having similar problems, or did the symptoms only start after the position was changed?

No, I was doing completely fine before the restructuring and managing my daily routine and art projects with no issues. All of this constant dread and defeat only started within a week or two of them switching my position and supervisor.
Since these work changes started, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that or any desire to hurt myself. While I am feeling incredibly overwhelmed, defeated, and stressed by all these changes at work, I definitely do not want to end my life.
Besides the job change, have there been any other major stressors or losses in your life around the same time, or is this mainly tied to the change at work?

No, there haven't been any other major losses or stressors in my life recently; this is entirely tied to the abrupt change at work. This transition has completely disrupted my home life, my art, and my daily routines, which is why it has hit me so hard. Everything else was going really well until they switched my position.
Has this work change caused problems that feel out of proportion to what you expected, or are you mainly feeling upset in a way that seems understandable given the situation?

I know anyone would be unhappy about a sudden job change, but my reaction feels completely overwhelming and out of control. I'm constantly on the verge of tears or snapping at people, I've stopped doing my art, and I'm falling behind at work. It feels much more severe than just being upset—it's completely taking over my entire life and routine.
Have your symptoms started to improve at all since the work change, or have they stayed the same or gotten worse?

They haven't improved at all; they've actually gotten much worse. Over the past month, instead of settling down, I’ve felt increasingly defeated, wound up, and on the verge of tears. It feels like the stress is just steadily escalating every day.
Have your symptoms started to improve now that you’re getting more used to the new position, or do they only happen when you’re at work and thinking about the job change?

No, they haven't improved at all, and they definitely don't just stay at work. These feelings follow me home every day, leaving me so wound up and defeated that I've backed out of plans with friends and completely neglected my art and household routine.
